prose.subject: Updated Payout Account & Invoice INV-21527
prose.body:
Hi Omar,

Hope you’re doing well.

We wanted to let you know that we recently updated our payment setup. Our treasury team has added a new payout account for future disbursements: valebrooksecurity60-treasury.testnet. This account is now linked directly to our domain for verification purposes.

Please update your records to reflect this change for all upcoming settlements. For reference, we have attached invoice INV-21527 for the amount of 5103.22 USDC, which covers the agreed services for this billing cycle.

Let us know if you need any further documentation or have questions about the new account details.

Best regards,
Ines Castell
Valebrook Security
